annotations.text:
TODAY
You land on a line chart whose axis runs 0-100%, so every real rate (8-27%) hugs the floor and the bands look identical.
The other four breakdowns are one pill-click away, one at a time - you can never see two cuts together, and nothing on the tab tells you the totals they are a share of.

REDESIGNED
1. Totals first - the denominator every table below is a share of.
2. Price is the one ORDERED dimension, so it stays the chart - as columns, on a 0-20% axis, with thin-sample bands greyed.
3. The three unordered cuts (staff, page, province) become ranked cards you read at once.
4. The old pills survive as a switcher for the detail table, so Stocks and every full table are still one click away.
Same tokens throughout: DM Sans, 12px radii, the existing stat-card, filter-pill and RTS-chip anatomy.
One data nit, not a design choice: provinces arrive slugified - "Metro-manila", "Davao-del-sur", "South-cotabato". I title-cased them here. Worth fixing where they are extracted, not in the view.
